About Leah Alexander

Hello! I am Leah, a passionate and patient primary educator based in Kochi, Kerala with over 6 years of experience mentoring young minds in Classes 1 through 4. My focus is transforming foundational learning from something intimidating into a fun, interactive journey that kids look forward to every week.

Whether your child is struggling with basic arithmetic concepts, mental math, reading fluency, or needs help expressing thoughts in English, I tailor every single lesson to their unique pace. We utilize Paathshala's live collaborative whiteboard, interactive math manipulatives, visual story cards, and gamified quizzes to build solid conceptual clarity.

I believe every child has limitless potential when given a supportive, encouragement-driven learning environment. Let's build your child's confidence together!

Leah's 3-Step Teaching Framework

Designed specifically to keep young children in Class 2 actively engaged, curious, and excited throughout their 1-on-1 session.

🎨

1. Visual & Interactive

No boring lectures. We use virtual math blocks, interactive whiteboards, and storytelling so abstract numbers make real sense.

🏆

2. Gamified Milestone Check

Every 15 minutes, we do a quick 2-question gamified quiz. Children earn stars and badges, boosting focus and motivation.

📊

3. Parent Progress Snapshot

After every class, parents receive a concise WhatsApp report with concept mastery notes and 1 playful practice activity.

Frequently Asked Questions by Parents

How does the 100% Free Trial Class work? ▼
The free trial is a 30-minute 1-on-1 live session with Leah Alexander. It includes a friendly assessment of your child's current learning level, an engaging mini-lesson on the interactive whiteboard, and 5 minutes of direct feedback with you to discuss personalized study goals. No payment details required.
What device does my child need for the class? ▼
Classes can be joined on any laptop, tablet (iPad or Android tablet), or desktop computer using Google Chrome. A touchscreen or tablet stylus is great for the interactive whiteboard, but a standard mouse works perfectly as well!
What if we need to reschedule a class? ▼
We know young children have unpredictable schedules! You can reschedule any class free of charge with at least 2 hours' notice directly through your Paathshala dashboard or by messaging Leah.
Are sessions recorded for revision? ▼
Yes! Every 1-on-1 session is safely recorded and available in your parent dashboard within 1 hour after class, alongside class whiteboard notes and worksheets.
